answer: Sybil attacks can be deterred by verifying optical speckle scattering inside a hardware vault. Each node pulses coherent light through a disordered crystal, matching the diffraction pattern against a challenge atlas. Because software cannot simulate optical scattering, an adversary must fabricate discrete micro-cavities, incurring steep foundry expenses per identity. However, severe thermal gradients near a desert oasis expand the crystal matrix, occasionally causing false rejections.
